announcements.title: What's New in v1.6.0
bullets: Your own playlists — the header has a Playlists menu listing every playlist you created, and each one opens in the same dashboard with search, filters, bulk delete, reorder, move and export
Tick several playlists and see them merged: one card per video, a chip for each playlist it's in, and Move takes a video out of every playlist you ticked
Video tags — the keywords the uploader gave a video, shown on every card and matched by search. Click a tag to filter by it, stack several to narrow
Delete a playlist you own, by name, from the menu — its videos stay on YouTube
New layout: stats and breakdowns moved into a sidebar you can collapse, search is a magnifier in the toolbar, and the panel is wider
TidyWL now sends usage counts — a random install ID and how many videos you've deleted, unliked and moved. Never which videos, never your playlist, never your account: https://tidywl.com/privacy/

announcements.title: YouTube Watch Later Tidy v1.6.0 is live — force-update if you don't have it yet
bullets: Open a new tab and go to chrome://extensions
Top-right corner: turn on Developer mode
Reload your YouTube tab — you should now be on v1.6.0 (the version is shown under the dashboard title)
